status: MEASURED. The attribution fix resolved ZERO fills on real data. Root cause found and corrected; a re-run is required to report matches.

attribution_actual_matches.verdict: ZERO matches against 420 known ids. That is an extraction defect, not an absence of evidence.

root_cause.defect: _row_venue_order_id looked for the execution object under the keys `execution`, `exec` and `fill`. The PMUS feed uses NONE of those.
root_cause.real_shape: EXEC_KEYS = (aggressorExecution, passiveExecution) -- the module's own execution_field_inventory already named them, and reported 2255 fill rows carrying 4510 execution objects (TWO per row) whose key set includes `order`.
root_cause.consequence: venue_order_id read null on every production fill, so the second ownership route could never fire and every leg still reported UNKNOWN_OWNER.
root_cause.how_found: by comparing the extractor's path against execution_field_inventory's path in the same module, after the production run returned 0 matches on 420 ids.

fix._exec_order_id: pulls the id out of ONE execution object (order / orderId / nested {id}).
fix._row_venue_order_candidates: returns (ours, every). Walks EXEC_KEYS, plus the unambiguous single-object and flat shapes.
fix.two_party_problem: A trade has two parties and the account is ONE of them. Both executions carry an order id. `isAggressor` on the payload says which is ours (True -> aggressorExecution, False -> passiveExecution).
fix.deliberate_asymmetry: A POSITIVE match against ids we track resolves ownership even without isAggressor, because an id of ours cannot belong to the counterparty. A NON-match on an id that may be the counterparty's proves nothing and leaves the fill UNKNOWN_OWNER -- it is never downgraded to OWNER_MANUAL. OWNER_MANUAL requires the row to identify WHICH execution is ours.
fix.money_fields: untouched. cost, qty and price are identical before and after; this change is attribution only.
fix.read_only_guard_preserved: built as pairs rather than by subscript assignment, because the module's test guard forbids every subscript assignment target as its proxy for 'writes no store key'.

cost_basis_result_from_the_same_run.overstatement_basis: established legs ONLY. NOT the difference against placeholder_cost_total_usd, because the 2 unestablished legs have no measured cost to subtract -- their cost stays UNKNOWN and is never treated as zero.
cost_basis_result_from_the_same_run.why_not_applied: correct_settled_market refuses it as CORRECTION_WOULD_RELAX_LOSS_HALT. Applying it moves realized toward zero and needs its own owner decision.

accounting_from_the_same_run.manual_unavailable_reason: UNATTRIBUTED_RESIDUAL_NONZERO: manual is a residual and is only meaningful once nothing is unattributable
accounting_from_the_same_run.label: A $1/share upper bound is an estimate, not a verified realized loss. verified_l5_realized counts ONLY attested L5 settlements after the 2026-10-16T02:45:12Z baseline.

covers: the real nesting is read at all (returned None on every production fill before)
isAggressor picks our execution, not the counterparty's
the real shape resolves to L5_OWNED
a positive match resolves even without the aggressor flag
a counterparty id alone stays UNKNOWN and is never called manual
our identified execution that is not ours IS manual
